name: Stiled
notes: Fashion shopping assistant on iMessage (Instagram in beta): finds items from screenshots and links, virtual try-on on your own photo, size by brand from your measurements, outfit feedback, packing lists. Try-ons cost a "stamp"; everything else is free. Requested via the form (issues #92, #93).
tagline: Your fashion shopping assistant, one text away

access.price: Free (1 stamp a day) · 10-stamp pack $3.99 · Pro $9.99/mo
